correctness.rationale: The ordered-chamber exponential solves the free Schrödinger equation with energy \(E_N=-\sum_{j=0}^{N-1}(\kappa-jg)^2\), satisfies the attractive Robin condition and the contact jump for coefficient \(2g\), and has a factorized gap-coordinate norm. All norm factors are positive exactly when \(\kappa>(N-1)g\). Its energy lies below the one-free-particle cluster threshold by the positive separation gap; positivity improvement identifies the state as the ground state. The outer-gap distribution gives the stated mean. The scope does not claim a complete spectrum.
